title: Dedicated capacity weekly 1:1 prep (Mar week)
summary: Prep notes and action items for weekly 1:1 with Marcus on dedicated GPU pool forecasts, reservations, and autoscaling policy tweaks.
content:
Quick notes for Tuesday 1:1 w/ Marcus (priority ordering: forecast -> reservations -> autoscale tweaks -> blockers)

Context / goal:
- Keep prod p95 latency SLAs for text-gen and embeddings during Q2 launch (new multimodal model + increased embeddings usage).
- Avoid over-committing reserved capacity (cost) while ensuring headroom for bursty traffic.

Current state (metrics last 7 days):
- Prod dedicated pool: 40 x A100-80GB reserved. Average GPU util 62%, p95 token throughput per-GPU ~4.2k tokens/s, p95 latency for gen 340ms.
- Burst pool: up to +20 GPUs (spot/HW pool) used 12% of time; average warmup time ~7m.
- Staging/dev: 8 x A100 reserved; low util.
- Cost baseline: internal blended cost ~$1,800/GPU-month (rough estimate) -> reserved cost ~ $72k/mo for prod pool. (Need finance verification)

Forecast (6-week view, rough):
- Baseline traffic growth: +8% week-over-week (observed last month on embeddings).
- Q2 model rollout (multimodal-v1) expected 20% additional token demand for gen paths starting mid-April.
- Conservatively, need +8 GPUs by mid-April to keep p95 < 400ms for gen; optimistic approach uses autoscale to handle bursts.

Simple forecast table (W0 = now):
- W0 (now): reserved 40, avg util 62%
- W2: reserved 40, projected util 74%
- W4: reserved 44 (if no other mitigations), projected util 82%
- W6: reserved 48 (if model rollout lands and we want <75% util target)

Reservations strategy options:
1) Do nothing now, rely on autoscale for bursts. Pros: saves reserved cost; Cons: warmup latency + risk of capacity shortage during concurrent bursts.
2) Add 8 reserved GPUs now (commit) to hit W4 demand. Pros: predictable throughput, simple; Cons: extra cost ~ $14k/mo.
3) Hybrid: reserve + plan pre-warm windows around scheduled traffic spikes (use scheduled warmups + autoscale for unplanned).

Autoscaling notes / ideas:
- Current autoscale policy: scale step +4 GPUs, cooldown 5m, warmup policy uses instance spin-up (avg 7m).
- Ideas: reduce scale step to +2 for smoother granularity; add faster provisioning for our cloud partner (ask infra for TB/Ticket).
- Implement pre-warm hooks: for known high-traffic runbooks (marketing campaigns, partner demos) -> pre-warm +10 GPUs 30m prior.
- Consider cached-KV aggressive reuse for multi-turn chat workloads to shave effective GPU load (applied-ml to estimate savings).

Risk / unknowns:
- H100 availability in our regions: if we can shift some gen jobs to H100 we might need fewer GPUs but availability/price risk. (Liam to check spot/HW availability).
- Quantization profile differences: some model variants are 8-bit quantized -> less GPU mem/compute; need mapping of which routes can use quantized variants without quality loss. (Sofia to run evals on top prompts).
- Finance unit cost is rough; need exact cost for A100 vs H100 reserved pricing before committing.

Notes to mention in 1:1:
- Recommend hybrid approach: reserve +8 GPUs targeted for mid-April with ability to cancel/scale if rollout delayed.
- Short-term: tweak autoscale (step -> 2, shorter cooldown) and create pre-warm runbook for scheduled spikes.
- Ask Marcus for sign-off to open reservation request (finance + procurement) if he agrees.

Unresolved questions to discuss:
- How aggressive do we want the reserved commit vs rely on autoscale? (tradeoff: ~ $14k/mo for 8 GPUs vs extra latency risk)
- Can infra reduce warmup time by pre-pulling images or keeping a small warm pool? (SRE impact/cost)
- Any contractual volume discounts if we commit >48 GPUs for next 6 months? (Finance to check)

Action items (short):
- A1: Draft reservation request for +8 A100-80GB (mid-April start) for procurement review. Owner: Ava. Due: 2026-03-10.
- A2: Ticket infra to investigate warmup time improvements + possibility to pre-pull images. Owner: Liam. Jira: JIRA-DED-1240. Due: 2026-03-09.
- A3: Sofia to run evals on quantized multimodal-v1 variants (top 50 prompts) and report potential GPU savings. Owner: Sofia. Due: 2026-03-16.
- A4: Finance: confirm unit reserved cost for A100 vs H100 and any discount tiers. Owner: Marcus (finance contact). Due: 2026-03-12.
- A5: Create pre-warm runbook + automated cron to pre-warm +10 GPUs 30m before scheduled campaigns. Owner: Ava + DevOps. Due: 2026-03-18.

Follow-up notes (for next weekly):
- Check actual util after autoscale tweaks (one-week window).
- If util still >80% during peaks, escalate reservation plan.

Quick links / refs:
- Confluence forecast doc: https://confluence.redwood/proj/dedicated-capacity#weekly-forecast
- Active ticket for runway: JIRA-DED-1234 (capacity planning)
- PR for autoscale config: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/987

Random personal scratch / talking points:
- Start the 1:1 with a 2-min summary: "hybrid recommendation, low-cost autoscale tweaks now, reservation decision by 3/10"
- If Marcus asks about risk: frame as "we can unroll reservation change if model rollout slips; autoscale is safety net but we need faster warmup"
- Keep options open for H100 migration if finance approves pilot (Liam to assess availability)

End of prep notes.
